defects.class: caller length truncated to int before a BIO length (out-of-bounds read)
defects.description: d2i_PrivateKey_ex passed its long length to OSSL_DECODER_from_data as a size_t, which passes it to BIO_new_mem_buf as an int; a negative or wider-than-int length truncated to a negative int, whose BIO spelling is strlen over the buffer. The legacy method callback also received length as c_int. The authority has the same implicit conversion.
defects.fix: Both entry points refuse a length outside 0..=INT_MAX before dereferencing the cursor, raising nothing (deliberate divergence on invalid input). Added control asn1::d2i_pr::tests::a_length_outside_int_range_is_refused_before_any_read.

defects.class: double free / use-after-free across the DSA lifecycle pair
defects.description: dsa_finish freed dsa->method_mont_p but left the freed pointer installed. DSA_set_method runs the outgoing table's finish and DSA_free runs the table's finish again through CtxDestroy::destroy_body, so a cached Montgomery context was released twice. The authority leaves the dangling pointer in place.
defects.fix: The hook clears method_mont_p after freeing it; recorded as a deliberate §17 divergence (the M17-D1 class). Added control dsa::ossl::tests::the_finish_hook_clears_the_mont_cache_it_releases.
